description: Chat-load daemon stage (perf100, daemon_bench.py): a real acpmux daemon opens 100-, 1,000- and 10,000-turn fixture chats the way the agent pane does and pages back to the first message; wall, CPU, read bytes and peak memory per open and per scroll, and the daemon's RSS.
not_measurable: run.sh takes ACPMUX_BIN OUT_DIR, not the runner's --app --tag --out, and the Linux runner builds no acpmux binary at the measured commit; run it by hand with PERF_RESULT_DIR set.
